title: Justin Mclaire celebrates love "OUTLOUD" in new EP
summary: Up-and-coming Kapamilya singer Justin Mclaire embraces his romantic side with his sophomore EP, “ OUTLOUD ,” a six-track collection that captures the excitement, comfort, and joy of falling in love.
